get.description: Authentication and transport CSRF precede path, query, revision and body validation. Owners recheck current authority, credential domain, target state, revision, uniqueness and related effects in their native snapshot or transaction. Object IDs are canonical signed int64 decimal strings, including zero and negative keys, without a plus sign or leading zeroes. Read fields are explicitly selected. Writes return only confirmed ID and revision metadata and never reread a target or actor after commit. Outcome-unknown is 503 without Retry-After; reconcile durable state before another operation. Responses use Cache-Control: no-store.
